info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get It Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The IT Management Retrieval API provides endpoints for fetching production release details based on specific parameters. It allows users to access critical information about IT management for their banking applications, enhancing operational efficiency. This API is particularly useful for developers and system integrators who need to retrieve detailed insights for reporting or integration purposes. By utilizing the parameterized endpoint, consumers can obtain tailored data that meets their business needs.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific production release.
get.description: This operation allows users to fetch information about a specific production release in the IT management system using its unique identifier. It provides all relevant details necessary for understanding the status and implications of the release.

requestBody.description: A JSON object representing the request body for retrieving the production release details associated with the specified ID. The request body must adhere to the defined schema and include all required fields.

GetItManagementByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body expected for the GET operation related to Production Release, specifically for PROD-700045.

GetItManagementByParam1Response_200.title: Production Release Response

systemId.description: Identifier of the system where the operation is executed.

environment.description: The environment in which the production release occurs.

changeId.description: Identifier for tracking the change related to this release.

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for the release.

plannedAt.description: The planned date and time for the release.

leasedAssetId.description: Identification for the leased asset involved in this operation.

residualValue.description: The residual value of the asset after its lease term.

leaseTermMonths.description: The duration of the lease term in months.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record e.g., active, archived.

version.description: The version of the release record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the production release.
